trap.label: irregular no texto
trap.wrong: Last weekend I go to the beach and swim.
trap.right: Last weekend I went to the beach and swam.
trap.why: Em narrativas, o aluno esquece de manter todos os verbos no passado; em inglês cada verbo da sequência vai ao passado.

mcq.q: Passado de **run**: (Past Simple (irregular): production and review)
Passado de **sit**: (Past Simple (irregular): production and review)

fix.wrong: I woke up and eat breakfast.
fix.right: I woke up and ate breakfast.
